definition: [ רָצַץ ] verb crush (Late Hebrew = Biblical Hebrew; Arabic bruise, bray, crush ; Aramaic רְעַ , crush, shatter ); — Qal Perfect 2 masculine singular suffix רַצּוֺתָנוּ 1Sam 12:4 1 singular רַצּוֺתִי v 1Sam 12:3 Imperfect 3 masculine singular יָּרוּץ ( Ges «GKC:67q»§ 67q ) Isa 42:4 (Babylonian Manuscript יֵרוֺץ , Niph`al, so SS here and Eccl 12:6 a), 3 feminine singular תָּרוּץ Eccl 12:6 a, 1 singular אָרֻץ Ps 18:30 = אָרוּץ 2Sam 22:30 (see below); Participle active feminine plural רֹצְצוֺת Amos 4:1 passive רָצוּץ Isa 42:3 +, construct רְצוּץ Hos 5:11 plural רְצוּצִים Isa 58:6 — crush: 1. literal, \ \ a. passive participle in (הַ)קָּנֶה (הָ)רָצוּץ 2Kgs 18:21 = Isa 36:6 ; Isa 42:3 (all metaphor of weak person). \ \ b. imperfect intransitive get crushed (read תֵּרוֺץ ?), of bowl Eccl 12:6 a (in metaphor). 2. figurative crush, oppress , accusative of person 1Sam 12:3 ; 1Sam 12:4 ; Amos 4:1 passive participle Deut 28:33 , as substantive the oppressed Isa 58:6 רְצוּץ מִשְׁפָּט Hos 5:11 ( We Now רֹצֵץ , i.e. perverting judgment , but dubious); intransitive get crushed (read יֵרוֺץ ?), of servant of ׳ י , under figure of wick, Isa 42:4 (+ יִכְהֶה ) he shall not grow dim or be crushed out. Niph`al be crushed, broken: Perfect 3 masculine singular consecutive נְרֹץ ( Ges «GKC:67t»§ 67t ) Eccl 12:6 b (of wheel at cistern); Imperfect 2 masculine singular תֵּרוֺץ Ezek 29:7 (of Pharaoh as reed, compare Qal 1 a ); Job 20:10 read perhaps יֵרֹצּוּ (for יְרַצּוּ , see רצה Pi`el), are crushed (as) poor men, Bu , compare Hoffm SS Gerber . — Isa 42:2 ; Eccl 12:6 a see Qal. Pi`el crush in pieces: 1. literal (in metaphor) Perfect 2 masculine singular רִצַּצְתָּ Ps 74:14 with accusative of thing. 2. figurative = grievously oppress , 3 masculine singular רִצַּץ Job 20:19 Imperfect 3 masculine singular וַיְרַצֵּץ מִן הָעָם 2Chr 16:10 . Po`el Imperfect 3 masculine plural וַיְרֹצְצוּ Judg 10:8 , accusative of person (= Pi`el 2 ; || רעץ ; רצץ here perhaps doublet, so GFM Hpt , compare Bu Now ). Hiph`il Imperfect 3 feminine singular וַתָּ֫רִץ ( Kö i. 352 ; Ba ZMG xliii (1889), 181 thinks Qal ) Judg 9:53 she crushed his skull. Hithpo`el reciprocal, Imperfect 3 masculine plural וִיִּתְרֹצְצוּ הַבָּנִים בְּקִרְבָּהּ Gen 25:22 ( J ) the children crushed (thurst, struck) one another within her.

1. literal,
\ \ a. passive participle in (הַ)קָּנֶה (הָ)רָצוּץ 2Kgs 18:21 = Isa 36:6; Isa 42:3 (all metaphor of weak person).
\ \ b. imperfect intransitive get crushed (read תֵּרוֺץ?), of bowl Eccl 12:6a (in metaphor).
2. figurative crush, oppress, accusative of person 1Sam 12:3; 1Sam 12:4; Amos 4:1 passive participle Deut 28:33, as substantive the oppressed Isa 58:6 רְצוּץ מִשְׁפָּט Hos 5:11 (We Now רֹצֵץ, i.e. perverting judgment, but dubious); intransitive get crushed (read יֵרוֺץ?), of servant of ׳י, under figure of wick, Isa 42:4 (+ יִכְהֶה) he shall not grow dim or be crushed out. Hiph`il Imperfect 3 feminine singular וַתָּ֫רִץ (Köi. 352; BaZMG xliii (1889), 181 thinks Qal) Judg 9:53 she crushed his skull.
